answer_4.quote: human evaluation is given to further assess the feasibility of JOIE in real scenarios... At the end of each session, users are required to give explicit feedback on whether the dialog succeeded with all the user constraints satisfied. Moreover, evaluators rate the dialog session on a scale from 1 to 5 about the quality (5 is the best, 1 is the worst).
answer_4.guideline: Users provide explicit feedback on dialog success and rate the overall quality on a 1‑5 scale.
